title: StudioErrorPayload
description: RFC 7807 style error payload used by /api/v3/studio. Error payloads are redacted and stable; internal exception strings and provider credentials never cross the boundary.

status.description: Canonical HTTP status per the frozen bootstrap error contract (studio_contract_v0.1/errors.json).

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code frozen in studio_contract_v0.1/errors.json.

details.description: Optional stable field/issue details. Never contains secrets.

retryable.description: Only set when a retry is known safe. Capability/provider unavailability is typed and fail-closed, never fake success.
